cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How are you scoring my picnic against last year's? Please show me the measure before calling it a success.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Attendance. If we beat last year, I get the larger events budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then separate attendance from satisfaction. What was last year's count, and where does mine stand?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Eighty last year, seventy today. But yours ran in the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Same counting method? Staff included both times? Please check before adjusting for weather; I need to know whether I'm ten behind or you're short of your budget target.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 numbers to distinguish actual underperformance from B's incentive target.

specificity.evidence: A1 picnic comparison and B2 funding, B4 counts make every requested fact tangible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 specific counting questions act on B's data rather than invoke a late clipboard reveal.
